ko: 나 같은 죄인 살리신 주 은혜 놀라워
en: Amazing grace! how sweet the sound That saved a wretch like me! I once was lost, but now am founWas blind, but now I see.

ko: 큰 죄악에서 건지신 주 은혜 고마워
나 처음 믿은 그 시간 귀하고 귀하다
en: grace that taught my heart to fear,And grace my fears relieved. How precious did that grace appear The hour I First believed!

ko: 이제껏 내가 산 것도 주님의 은혜라
en: Thro' many dangers, toils, and snares I have already come.
'Tis grace hath bro't me safe thus far, And grace will lead me home
When we've been there ten thousand years, Bright shining as the sun, We've no less days to sing God's praise Than when we first begun
